About Us

Our clothes are confected with vibrant color palettes, finest embroideries, delicate embellishments, and smooth fabrics. We fabricate designs with an aura of cultural heritage as well as true modern styles. By infusing classic styles with contemporary cuts, we create outfits representing sophistication and elegance. From upstream to downstream, Khalom produces high quality fabric, aesthetically appealing designs and intricately needled impressions to stay ahead of the innovation curve.
